questions.question: What is a line of symmetry? How many does a rectangle have, and why are its diagonals not lines of symmetry?
questions.expected_answer: A line along which a figure folds so the halves match exactly. A non-square rectangle has 2 (vertical and horizontal); folding along a diagonal makes the corners miss, so the halves do not match.

questions.question: Give the number of lines of symmetry of an equilateral triangle, a square, a regular octagon and a circle.
Explain how to complete a symmetrical figure on squared paper using a vertical mirror line.
questions.expected_answer: For each vertex, count the squares straight across to the mirror line, count the same number on the other side, mark the image vertex, then join the vertices in order. Fold to check.
